items.title: ‘Another wrong signal’: Jackdaw approval draws widespread criticism from green economy
items.summary: The UK Government’s approval of the controversial Jackdaw gas project has drawn significant criticism from across the green economy, reigniting concerns over the UK’s energy policy, climate commitments and continued support for North Sea oil and gas production.

items.title: Jackdaw approval: What is it good for?

items.title: Revealed: Expensive gas behind ‘nearly 90%’ of rise in UK electricity bills
items.summary: A surge in wholesale costs driven by expensive gas is responsible for nearly 90% of the rise in UK household electricity bills since 2020, reveals new analysis.

items.title: 恆春灰面鵟鷹過境創新高、東京大阪破30℃創百年最晚紀錄、聯合國確認增溫1.5℃難以避免
items.summary: 在氣候變遷、超高齡社會的挑戰下，衛福部與環境部今天攜手逾200家醫療衛生等機構成立永續聯盟。衛生福利部長石崇良指出，衛福部醫事司自2024年起，已輔導約百家醫療機構進行碳盤查、50家推動節能管理，並補助32家培育綠色醫療人才；如今升級成立大聯盟，就是要建立跨部會、跨領域的對話平台，讓各家醫院互相「借鏡學習」，不再單打獨鬥摸索減碳。
